summary: [spec-fidelity] The context.status.60 test contradicts the reworded scenario. The Given wants a building subject with two changes, one tagged and one approved-line, both approved. The test seeds c-first with no approval and no tagged scenario, so c-first is a pending draft. The test then asserts the human step `demo-subject`, while the Then says `no step is addressed to a human`. The `reason: tagged` entry is never produced, and the doc comment still describes the newest-change rule. Fix: seed a tagged approved change plus an approved-line change and assert two approved entries and no human step.
